sources_checked_or_revisited.action: Extracted e-BY post-selection FCR guarantee under arbitrary selection/dependence for already-valid e-CIs, plus sequential/stopping-time applicability and real A/B evidence.

sources_checked_or_revisited.title: AV-AIVAT: 74x Cheaper Agent Evaluation with Certified Anytime-Valid Stopping in Imperfect-Information Games
sources_checked_or_revisited.authors: Boning Li, Yu Chen, Longbo Huang
sources_checked_or_revisited.action: Extracted agent-evaluation variance reduction, stopping-time savings, exact-vs-asymptotic CS distinction, held-out calibration, and optional-stopping stress tests.

sources_checked_or_revisited.title: Combining Evidence Across Filtrations
sources_checked_or_revisited.action: Extracted failure of coarse-filtration e-process validity under finer-information stopping and the adjuster-based e-lifting remedy.

new_or_updated_candidate_findings.mechanism: For adaptively selected evaluation metrics, candidate gates, or continuously monitored endpoints, construct each marginal statement as a valid e-CI/confidence sequence under its actual data-dependence assumptions, then apply e-BY after selection. Keep dependency-model selection separate: e-BY cannot rescue a marginal interval that was invalid because the wrong clustering/dependence model was chosen.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.evidence: Xu, Wang and Ramdas prove e-BY FCR control at target delta with no restriction on the selection rule or dependence among already-valid e-CIs. The construction also supports stopped confidence sequences. In a Twitter A/B dataset spanning 1.5 years with 263 experiments and K=30 treatment/control parameters, at delta=0.1 e-BY justified shipping in 127 experiments versus 122 for BY; among experiments both methods could ship, mean decision time was 1.2 versus 1.5 days. Simulations also covered K from 10 to 1000 under multiple signal sizes and dependence settings.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.scope: Post-selection among valid e-value/e-CI constructions. It does not validate selecting an incorrect dependence model or finer clustering level on the same data.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.uncertainty: FCR is not automatically the right objective for a single high-stakes pass/fail gate; agent-specific endpoint selection and family structure need explicit design.

new_or_updated_candidate_findings.mechanism: When model/variant assignment can be randomized at the independent task/cluster or matched-pair level, base small-sample comparison on permutation/randomization at that assignment unit rather than treating trajectories/steps as independent. Prefer design-based inference when there are only tens of independent tasks and asymptotic cluster formulas are fragile.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.evidence: Hagemann's 2,000-replication simulations at nominal 5% show placebo inference near target under very few clusters: with 3 treated + 3 controls, placebo 5.35%, Ibragimov-Mueller 2.2%, wild bootstrap 8.55%, ordinary t test 16.05%; with 6 treated + 2 controls, placebo 5.30% versus wild bootstrap 9.05%. Bai et al. similarly find matched-pair randomization tests control size more reliably than cluster-robust alternatives for fewer than about 50 pairs. In one Model-1 setting with G=12 pairs, RT size was 0.0395, conventional CR 0.0015, and PCVE 0.0770; at G=26 and 50 pairs RT remained near 0.05.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.scope: Requires a valid randomized/exchangeable assignment or a null under which the permutation is justified. It is not a generic fix for observational benchmark comparisons.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.uncertainty: Need direct agent-benchmark experiments with bounded paired rewards, repeated rollouts per task, and heterogeneous task difficulty.

new_or_updated_candidate_findings.mechanism: For expensive noisy agent comparisons, pair a predictable past-only variance-reduction/control-variate correction with sequential confidence sequences. Keep two evidence tracks: a practical/asymptotic screen calibrated on held-out data, and an exact certificate only when an independently justified almost-sure bound exists. Never use the observed sample maximum as proof of the exact bound; persist prefix/stopping/correction/bound provenance for replay.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.evidence: AV-AIVAT evaluates 15 agent configurations over 71,439 paired HUNL hands. Median raw/AIVAT variance ratio is 54.4x [24.2,86.0]; median raw/AIVAT AsympCS stopping-time ratio at +/-1 BB is 74.17x [54.53,97.62]. Yet the EB-CS stopping ratio is only 1.365x [1.235,1.556] over 14 evaluable runs, showing that variance reduction does not imply comparable exact-CS savings when the range/bet cap dominates width. At +/-0.5 BB all raw AsympCS streams were censored by 4,028-5,000 hands while AIVAT median stopping was 56.5 hands [42.5,71]. In a zero-effect optional-stopping stress test, naively peeking at fixed 95% intervals yielded 1,227/2,000 = 61.35% false nonzero claims; at those selected prefixes EB-CS contained zero in 1,227/1,227 and AsympCS in 1,226/1,227. A separate 5,000-hand standalone AsympCS check still showed 208/2,000 = 10.4% false positives, underlining that its guarantee is asymptotic rather than exact.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.scope: Primary empirical scope is imperfect-information game agents. HUNL corrected-payoff EB-CS is descriptive because no independent analytic bound for the corrected stream was available. Ground-truth Leduc provides an independently justified |Y|<=117 bound and stronger exact-CS evidence.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.uncertainty: The optional-stopping resampling simulation does not preserve temporal dependence or run-level clustering. Extension to hierarchical/crossed agent evaluation needs a corresponding dependence model.

new_or_updated_candidate_findings.mechanism: Match the stopping rule's information set to the filtration under which an e-process/confidence sequence is valid. If a task-level/coarse statistic is valid only for coarse arrivals but stopping is allowed to inspect finer trajectory, step, tool, or evaluator signals, either restrict stopping to the coarse filtration or lift/adjust the evidence into the finer filtration before using the richer stopping information.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.evidence: Choe and Ramdas show that an e-process valid for a coarse filtration need not remain valid at stopping times in a richer filtration. Their Bernoulli example stops after five consecutive zeros using finer information and demonstrates failure of the coarse conformal test martingale at that stopping rule. Their e-lifting construction applies an adjuster to the running maximum of the coarse e-process, restoring anytime validity in the finer filtration, at an unavoidable evidence-efficiency cost for generic lifting.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.scope: General e-process/filtration theory. It does not by itself specify the correct task/trajectory clustering model; the filtration must faithfully encode all information visible to the stopping/selection policy.
new_or_updated_candidate_findings.uncertainty: Need agent-specific simulations quantifying the power cost of lifting versus restricting stopping to task boundaries, especially under crossed task x judge/policy dependence.

scoped_or_rejected_leads.lead: e-BY post-selection validity makes same-data dependence-model selection safe.
scoped_or_rejected_leads.reason: Rejected. e-BY assumes the marginal e-CIs/e-processes supplied to it are already valid; it cannot repair a confidence process made invalid by choosing the wrong clustering/dependence model.

scoped_or_rejected_leads.lead: A 54x variance reduction implies roughly 54x savings for an exact confidence-sequence stopping rule.
scoped_or_rejected_leads.reason: Rejected. AV-AIVAT reports median 54.4x variance reduction but only 1.365x EB-CS stopping-time ratio in the HUNL descriptive exact-track replay because the declared range/bet cap creates a width floor.

scoped_or_rejected_leads.lead: The AV-AIVAT 74x result is a general certified finite-sample speedup for agent evaluation.
scoped_or_rejected_leads.reason: Rejected. 74.17x is the median HUNL AsympCS stopping ratio for the tested 15 configurations; AsympCS is asymptotic, and the HUNL corrected stream lacked an independently justified analytic bound for an exact EB-CS claim.

scoped_or_rejected_leads.lead: A confidence sequence valid at task boundaries remains anytime-valid if stopping also looks at step-level or trajectory-internal evidence.
scoped_or_rejected_leads.reason: Rejected in general. Coarse-filtration validity need not survive stopping in a richer filtration; explicit lifting/adjustment or restricted stopping is required.

scoped_or_rejected_leads.lead: Randomization/permutation inference is a universal fix for few tasks.
scoped_or_rejected_leads.reason: Rejected. Its finite-sample validity depends on the assignment/exchangeability/null structure; arbitrary observational benchmark comparisons do not inherit that guarantee.

frontier_queue.action: Find primary methods that combine cluster-aware or paired bounded outcomes with anytime-valid confidence sequences/e-processes, preferably with only 10-50 independent tasks, and extract finite-sample type-I/coverage and stopping-time results.

Search selective/post-selection inference that can choose among candidate dependency structures or clustering levels while retaining valid downstream sequential inference, beyond simple full sample splitting.

Construct an agent-evaluation design map separating: randomized paired-task inference, coarse-filtration task-boundary stopping, lifted finer-filtration stopping, and crossed task x judge/policy dependence; identify where each guarantee breaks.
Deep-extract ground-truth Leduc and held-out calibration tables from AV-AIVAT to quantify exact EB-CS versus asymptotic screen tradeoffs under independently justified bounds.
Search direct benchmark/agent papers that use randomization inference over tasks or matched task pairs and compare against cluster-robust/bootstrap baselines.

early_termination_avoidance: The prior dependency-unit-selection frontier was extended into three distinct validity layers: post-selection among already-valid e-CIs, design-based few-cluster randomization, and anytime-valid stopping under filtration mismatch. A direct 2026 agent-evaluation source added a fourth mechanism separating practical asymptotic screening from exact certification. None is treated as globally solved; each leaves explicit scope and failure modes.
exact_next_action: Prioritize primary cluster-aware/paired bounded anytime-valid inference for only 10-50 independent tasks; then look for selection-aware dependency-structure choice that remains valid under sequential stopping without a full data split.
